verdict: Typical Unlimited Base Set card $2.12 (median of the 101 cards' 30-day sold medians at the BS99 Oct 1, 2026 mark; 76 under $5, 94 under $20). Raw sold medians read Oct 6: Base Charizard 4 Unl $400.00 (30, Sep 28–Oct 5), Shadowless $1,009.00 (4, Sep 7–17), 1st Ed $12,706.00 (5, Jul 18–Aug 31, 90d); Unl Charizard PSA 9 $3,500.00 (7 dated PSA 9 sales, Sep 8–29); Blastoise 2 $92.00 (30, Sep 30–Oct 6); Venusaur 15 $67.50 (30, Sep 25–Oct 6); Machamp 8 1st Ed $12.76 (30, Sep 25–Oct 2); Pikachu 58 Unl $3.21 (30, Sep 27–Oct 5), 1st Ed $185.00 (5, Sep 6–23); Jungle Snorlax 11 $57.50 (30, Sep 25–Oct 5), Jolteon 4 $42.50 (30, Sep 25–Oct 1); Fossil Dragonite 4 $89.50 (30, Sep 23–Oct 4), Gengar 5 $88.08 (30, Sep 28–Oct 5); Team Rocket Dark Charizard 4 $235.25 (30, Sep 19–29); Neo Genesis Lugia 9 $450.00 (30, Sep 16–Oct 5). 19 classic index levels from data/indices.json history (Oct 1 / Oct 4 marks) each with its own '100 = <Mon YYYY>' base.
